title: Purge audio assets from git history
description: Inventory every audio file ever committed (all extensions, all branches; known: web/public/hero/*.mp3). Run git filter-repo to remove them as though never committed; .gitignore web/public/hero and audio extensions. Do AFTER T22 (ae24ae) with a clean tree. Coordinate develop branch + worktree + other sessions (hashes change). Never force-push without explicit user go-ahead; hero MP3s were probably pushed to origin (public AnthusAI/Apricity), so GitHub caches/forks may retain them.
